components.name: Primary Download Button
components.description: Blue beta-download action used in the header and hero.
components.html: Télécharger la bêta
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 48px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 20px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: #275dad; color: #fff; font: 600 16px/1.5 'IBM Plex Sans Variable', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: #1f4f9d; } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #275dad; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-button-primary:active { background: #1f4f9d; }

components.name: Inverse Download Button
components.description: White high-contrast download action on the dark closing panel.
components.html: Choisir ma version
components.css: .ds-button-inverse { display: inline-flex; min-height: 48px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 6px; background: #fff; color: #171a21; font: 600 16px/1.5 'IBM Plex Sans Variable', sans-serif; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 160ms ease; } .ds-button-inverse:hover { background: #e6eaf1; } .ds-button-inverse:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #98acff; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-button-inverse:active { background: #e6eaf1; }

components.name: Site Navigation
components.description: Quiet desktop section links paired with a persistent download action.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 28px; font: 400 14px/1.5 'IBM Plex Sans Variable', sans-serif; color: #344054; } .ds-nav a { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; color: inherit; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav a:hover { color: #171a21; } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #275dad; outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 3px; }

components.name: Marginalia Application Capture
components.description: Actual application capture with a local Markdown sample; the crop excludes machine-specific path details.
components.css: .ds-app-capture { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid #c7cdd6; border-radius: 8px; background: #fff; box-shadow: 0 12px 28px rgb(23 26 33 / 10%); } .ds-app-capture a { position: relative; display: block; cursor: zoom-in; } .ds-app-capture img { display: block; width: 100%; height: auto; } .ds-app-capture .ds-zoom { position: absolute; right: 12px; bottom: 12px; display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; gap: 8px; padding: 8px 12px; border: 1px solid #c7cdd6; border-radius: 6px; background: #fff; color: #275dad; font: 600 12px/1.5 'IBM Plex Sans Variable', sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 4px 10px rgb(23 26 33 / 12%); } .ds-app-capture .ds-zoom svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; } .ds-app-capture figcaption { margin-top: 12px; color: #475467; font: 400 12px/1.5 'IBM Plex Sans Variable', sans-serif; }

components.name: FAQ Disclosure
components.description: Hairline-separated native disclosure question with a plus/minus state cue.
components.html:
Marginalia modifie-t-il mes fichiers Markdown ?

Vous choisissez quand enregistrer les modifications et où exporter votre PDF.
components.css: .ds-faq { border-top: 1px solid #c7cdd6; font-family: 'IBM Plex Sans Variable', sans-serif; } .ds-faq:last-child { border-bottom: 1px solid #c7cdd6; } .ds-faq summary { display: flex; min-height: 60px; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 20px; cursor: pointer; list-style: none; color: #171a21; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 500; } .ds-faq summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-faq summary::after { color: #275dad; content: '+'; font-size: 21px; } .ds-faq[open] summary::after { content: '−'; } .ds-faq p { max-width: 68ch; margin: 0; padding: 0 0 20px; color: #344054; line-height: 1.7; } .ds-faq summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #275dad; outline-offset: 4px; border-radius: 3px; }

components.name: Mobile Menu Control

components.css: .ds-menu-toggle { display: inline-flex; min-width: 44px; min-height: 44px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid #c7cdd6; border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; color: #171a21; } .ds-menu-toggle:hover { background: #eef1f5; } .ds-menu-toggle:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #275dad; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-menu-toggle:active { background: #eef1f5; }

narrative.overview:
The site presents Marginalia as an editorial atelier: a clear working surface where visitors see a genuine capture of the Markdown editor and rendered reading view. Pale pearl paper, white sheets, slate ink, and the logo's blue accent carry the identity. The editorial serif supplies a reading voice; sans-serif interface labels and copy keep the interface precise and usable.

The signature composition is an open folio: concise explanation and a direct beta action face the actual application. The capture contains an authored local sample document and is cropped to exclude machine-specific path details. Fine rules and restrained shadows organize the page without turning it into a generic card grid. Responsive behavior stacks the folio copy and screenshot while preserving the image's aspect ratio.
keyCharacteristics: Pearl-gray page ground with white paper surfaces and slate typography.
Blue is reserved for actions, links, selected states, and small markers.
Editorial serif headlines paired with IBM Plex Sans interface text.
Folio composition, real application capture, thin rules, and restrained depth.
dos: Do preserve the pearl-paper, slate-ink, and logo-blue relationship across new site elements.
Do use IBM Plex Serif for editorial display headings and IBM Plex Sans for interface and body text.
Do use thin gray rules and white surfaces to structure content before adding depth.
Do keep labels and annotations compact and legible; uppercase demo captions use the established tracking.
Do stack the folio copy and screenshot at the documented breakpoint while preserving the screenshot's aspect ratio.
donts: Don't use the blue accent as a broad page background; its observed role is action, link, selection, and small orientation cues.
Don't replace the open-folio composition with a grid of generic rounded cards.
Don't rely on shadow alone where the implementation uses a clear rule or pane boundary.
